question: Why does the unchanged baseline public double-talk detector assert heavily on the 7GT upstream farend_singletalk recording while asserting much less on 49II, and do the exact Activity mic/reference energy ratios observed inside the unchanged pipeline explain that pure-far false-positive tendency?

source.rating_formula: last half of the common-length farend_singletalk clip

selection.rule: inherit only the two no-movement farend_singletalk cases from same-guid-farend-doubletalk-paired-v1; no case search or optimization

observation_method.processor_profile: ap_config_default(AP_PROFILE_CALL), io_sample_rate_hz=16000, mic_channels=1, BF disabled exactly as examples/process_pcm.c
observation_method.energy_recovery: invert the existing smooth_energy update from consecutive internal smoothed energies; first frame uses the observed smoothed value directly
numeric_cross_checks: recovered mic energy versus unchanged pipeline input_rms_dbfs
recovered reference energy versus unchanged synced pipeline reference buffer energy
public double_talk_active versus far_end_active and internal double_talk_hangover state

published_metrics: public DTD fraction conditional on far_end_active
exact reconstructed instant mic/reference energy ratio
exact internal smoothed mic/reference energy ratio
ratio distributions split by public DTD state
prohibited_actions: change public DTD semantics or metrics ABI
change 1.5, 0.90, 0.72, 1e-7, EMA alpha, or hangover values
derive a replacement DTD threshold from these two recordings
search or optimize a ratio boundary
treat upstream farend_singletalk as proof of perfectly isolated physical echo-only conditions beyond its dataset label
revive I009 echo-normalized or residual-echo rescue
relax pure-far, movement, echo-path-change, Hosted Real AEC, HIL, or Product Certification gates
interpretation_rule: This diagnostic may establish whether the unchanged Activity detector's own mic/reference energy-ratio evidence coincides with the observed pure-far public DTD assertions. It cannot by itself prove the physical cause of the upstream recording gain relationship, define a corrected threshold, or authorize a source candidate.
